# gocache_dns_record (Resource)

Manages a GoCache DNS record.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) DNS record content.
- `domain` (String) Domain name.
- `name` (String) DNS record name.
- `type` (String) DNS record type, such as A, CNAME or TXT.

### Optional

- `cloud` (Number) Whether the DNS record is served by GoCache. Use 1 for enabled and 0 for disabled.
- `ttl` (Number) DNS record TTL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) DNS record identifier.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last Terraform update.
